title: What's Venus retrograde?
caption: About every year and a half, Venus seems to slide backward for six weeks. Astrology calls it a rethink season for love.

beats.head: About every *year and a half,* it seems to go backward.
beats.sub: Seen from Earth. Same passing-lane illusion as Mercury.

beats.head: Old feelings tend to *resurface.*
beats.sub: An ex in your notifications is a memory, not a sign.

beats.head: Not a *ban* on dating. A slower pace.
beats.sub: Great for real talks. Not for rushed decisions.

vis.q: What do you actually want right now?

beats.head: Space fact: Venus draws a *star.*
beats.sub: Over eight years, its five retrogrades land in a near-perfect pentagram.

beats.head: Tag the friend who just got a *'hey stranger.'*
